name: web-black-and-yellow-group-marketplace-desktop-preview
title: Black-and-yellow crowd marketplace pages with globe lines, tape ticker, chip cloud and yellow feature blocks
whatItIs: Two overlapping desktop pages: a black hero with globe lines and a headline 'THE WORLD'S FIRST MARKETPLACE FOR CONSUMER GROUP ACTIVATIONS.', a yellow tape ticker, chip cloud, 'BUILT FOR BRANDS' with a yellow tracking block; and a second page with a radial orbit graphic, logos, a yellow 'coming to iOS' block and a dark contact form.
whatItMeans: Loud and urban; yellow on black feels like live activation.
techniques: Yellow tape ticker across the hero.
Radial orbit graphic as a feature visual.

vocabulary.definition: A yellow block presenting one benefit.
